area.name: Exeter

model.trained_on: HM Land Registry Price Paid Data 1995-2019, 24.3M transactions

area.geo_sources: AHAH v4 air quality & health POIs; ONS postcode centroids via Geovation; drive time approximated from straight-line distance at 30 km/h within the city
area.view_sources: Environment Agency LIDAR composite 1 m DSM/DTM (OGL); OS OpenMap Local buildings, water, woodland (OGL); Copernicus GLO-30 terrain. Outlooks computed per postcode from the nearest open ground to its centre, not per house.
